section.42: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering

42.name_native: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Uthman that:a physician made mention of the use of frogs in a remedy in the presence of the Messenger of Allah and the Messengher of Allah forbade killing them. (sahih)
